classification: Screenshot-fitted intermediate improvement; strict 2px acceptance remains FAIL in three explored cases.
stateRules: A fresh stroke resets vertical fraction and chooses its impulse from pre-reset feet. Rising into the surface band enables stronger gravity; descending beyond the band disables it. After surface contact, neutral gravity applies until landing or area load. Entry falls retain their separately measured gravity.

provenance.training: 24 explored cases, maximum error 97px to3px; all nine previously passing guards retained.
provenance.reserved: Two cases evaluated once after freeze, both maximum2px; no subsequent tuning.
provenance.remaining: water-surface-pulses first +3px at158; heldout-23frame-strokes first +3px at270; heldout-long-strokes first -3px at240. Frames are actual native frames after settled reset.

limits: Values and geometric state are inferred from small-player images. Big/fire-player strokes, currents, combat and 2-native-frame timing equivalence remain unmeasured. This is not a water acceptance pass or campaign win.
